items.title: Retarget existing DeviceRegistry previews to ARM common types v5
items.summary: Changes @armCommonTypesVersion from v6 to v5 on the existing 2026-11-01-preview and 2026-11-02-preview enum members; no API version is added or published. The frozen 2026-11-02-preview comparison propagates this single shared dependency change to 109 existing management operations through common ARM resource, error, identity, operation-list and status schemas. These are dependency relationships, not 109 authored lifecycle features. Local wire fields are unchanged, but the referenced common schemas are unresolved in canonical evidence; their compatibility is not established.

blockers.message: Changed AutoRest contracts for 109 operations in project-dd25e6db7b7b contain unresolved schema or parameter references (AssetEndpointProfiles_CreateOrReplace, AssetEndpointProfiles_Delete, AssetEndpointProfiles_Get). Their effective compatibility cannot be established from placeholder references.

guidance.excerpt: Decorators are referenced using the `@` prefix and must be placed before the entity they are decorating. Arguments can be provided by using parentheses, similar to function calls in many programming languages, e.g., `@myDec1("hi", { a: string })`.

intentAssessments.expected: Specify dependencies and common types per API-version enum member, with decorators placed before the declarations they decorate.
intentAssessments.actual: The two existing preview members retain explicit @armCommonTypesVersion decorations immediately before their enum members; only the common-types argument changes from v6 to v5. Version names, values and the latest preview marker are unchanged.
intentAssessments.rationale: The source hunk satisfies the retrieved per-version dependency-declaration and decorator-placement guidance. Neither cited section requires the newest common-types version or a new API version merely for selecting an existing dependency. The versioning overview's publication transitions and common-type-authoring guide do not govern this consuming-service edit. This scoped modeling pass is not a wire-compatibility pass: unresolved external v6/v5 schemas remain a separate assessment limit.

blockers: REST compatibility is not fully assessed: every one of the 237 supplied wire-schema candidates changes an external common-types v6 reference to v5 while the canonical before/after facts mark both referenced schemas unresolved. The missing definitions are ErrorResponse, TrackedResource, ProxyResource, SystemAssignedServiceIdentity, OperationListResult and OperationStatusResult. Explicit rejection means insufficient evidence for a confirmed finding, not equivalence or safety; concrete nested fields, requiredness, constraints and serialized value sets cannot be compared.

The 109 canonical operation pairs also retain unresolved external ApiVersionParameter, ResourceGroupNameParameter, SubscriptionIdParameter and OperationIdParameter references retargeted from v6 to v5. Local route, request/response, header, media-type and LRO fields otherwise compare unchanged; unavailable external parameter definitions prevent a complete wire assessment.

Frozen-preparation replay compares 2026-11-02-preview at the actual PR target/head commits. The source also edits the existing 2026-11-01-preview dependency, but no separate compiler comparison for that API version is supplied; this report must not imply independent coverage of both version outputs.
